title: The Vampire Loses Its Fangs/Quotes
summary:
"Alright! Transylvania here we come!"
- Lok Lambert

"He was my whole world."
- Dante to Zhalia Moon, about Metz"

"Zhalia, there's something I've been meaning to say. And that is.. Raypulse!
- Dante Vale to Zhalia Moon

"No ticket."
- Dante Vale to train passengers after throwing a Suit out of the window

"I still have the advantage." (Klaus) 

"You have nothing, not even the ground underneath your feet!" (Dante Vale before summoning Metagolem)
